questions.question: The component of white light that deviates the most on passing through a glass prism is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**violet**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Violet** light **deviates the most** when passing through a glass prism.
 
• This is due to the fact that violet light has the **shortest wavelength **of all the colors in visible light, and shorter wavelengths are refracted more than longer wavelengths.
 
• The phenomenon of light splitting into its constituent colors is called **dispersion**, and it occurs because different wavelengths of light are refracted by different amounts.
 
• The order of colors from least to most deviation through a prism is red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet (often remembered by the acronym **ROYGBIV**).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Isaac Newton** was the first to demonstrate that white light is made up of a spectrum of colors by using a glass prism.
 
• When white light enters a prism, it slows down and bends. Each color bends by a different amount because each color travels at a different speed in the glass.
 
• This separation of light into different colors is what produces the **spectrum**.
 
• In natural phenomena, dispersion is responsible for the formation of **rainbows**, where sunlight is dispersed by water droplets in the atmosphere.

__
 
• **Testes** are located outside the abdominal cavity in a pouch called the **scrotum**.
 
• This positioning helps in **maintaining the temperature** 2-3 degrees lower than the body temperature, which is essential for **sperm formation**.

• In colder conditions, the **cremaster muscle** also contracts to pull the testes closer to the body for warmth.
 
• This temperature regulation mechanism is vital for maintaining **sperm viability and fertility**.
 
• Additionally, the lower temperature in the scrotum helps in **preventing damage** to the developing sperm cells.

Hariteja walked to his school at a speed of 4 km/h and returned on a scooter at 20 km/h, His average speed during the two way journey is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Speed while walking to school = 4 km/h

Speed while returning on a scooter = 20 km/h

**Formula Used**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation**

If the distance to school is d km.

Time to school = Distance / Speed = d/4

Time to return = Distance / Speed = d/20

Total distance for the two-way journey = 2d km

⇒ Time to school = d/4

⇒ Time to return = d/20

Total time = d/4 + d/20 = (5d + d)/20 = 6d/20 = 3d/10

Average speed = Total distance/Total time

⇒ Average speed = 2d / (3d / 10) = (2 × 10) / 3 = 20/3

**∴ His average speed during the two-way journey is 20/3 km/h.**

questions.question: A concave mirror having focal length of magnitude 20 cm forms a real image at a distance of 60 cm from it. The object distance (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

**Concave Mirror Formula:**

__
 
• The relationship between object distance (u), image distance (v), and focal length (f) of a concave mirror is given by the mirror formula:
 
• **Mirror Formula:** (1)/(f) = (1)/(v) + (1)/(u) 
 
• Here, **f** is the focal length (cm), **v** is the image distance (cm), and **u** is the object distance (cm).
 
• The focal length (f) of a concave mirror is negative, and the image distance (v) for a real image is also negative.
 
• **Real Image:** An image formed where the light rays converge. It is inverted and can be projected onto a screen.
 
• **SI Unit:** The SI unit of focal length is meter (m), but in this context, we use centimeters (cm).
 
• **Dimensional Formula:** The dimensional formula for focal length is [L].

 

**Calculation:**__

Given,

Focal length, f = -20 cm

Image distance, v = -60 cm

Using mirror formula,

(1)/(f) = (1)/(v) + (1)/(u)

⇒ (1)/(-20) = (1)/(-60) + (1)/(u)

⇒ (1)/(u) = (1)/(-20) - (1)/(-60)

⇒ (1)/(u) = (-3 + 1)/(60)

⇒ (1)/(u) = (-2)/(60)

⇒ (1)/(u) = -(1)/(30)

⇒ u = -30 cm

**∴ The object distance is -30 cm.**

(i) Li, Na, K

(ii) Ca, Sr, Ba

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**only iii**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dobereiner's Triads:** Johann Wolfgang Döbereiner was a German chemist who is best known for his work that led to the development of the periodic table. He identified groups of three elements (triads) that had similar properties and observed that the atomic weight of the middle element was approximately the average of the atomic weights of the other two elements.
 
• The triads mentioned in the options are as follows:
 
 
• (i) Li, Na, K
 
• (ii) Ca, Sr, Ba
 
• (iii) N, P, Sb
 
• (iv) Cl, Br, I
 
 
 
• **Explanation:**
 
 
• **Option (i): Li, Na, K** - This is a valid Dobereiner's triad as Lithium (Li), Sodium (Na), and Potassium (K) all belong to Group 1 (**Alkali metals**) and show similar properties.
 
• **Option (ii): Ca, Sr, Ba** - This is a valid Dobereiner's triad as Calcium (Ca), Strontium (Sr), and Barium (Ba) all belong to Group 2 (**Alkaline earth metals**) and show similar properties.
 
• **Option (iii): N, P, Sb** - This is NOT a valid Dobereiner's triad. Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), and Antimony (Sb) do not form a triad with similar properties and the atomic weight of P is not the average of N and Sb.
 
• **Option (iv): Cl, Br, I** - This is a valid Dobereiner's triad as Chlorine (Cl), Bromine (Br), and Iodine (I) all belong to Group 17 (**Halogens**) and show similar properties.
 
 
 
• **Conclusion:** Therefore, the triad that is NOT a Dobereiner's triad is Option (iii): N, P, Sb.

• **CO** acts as a **reducing agent **in the given reaction.
 
• In the reaction: **Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂**, carbon monoxide (CO) reduces ferric oxide (Fe₂O₃) to iron (Fe).
 
• A reducing agent is a substance that loses electrons and reduces another substance by giving electrons.
 
• Here, **CO** is oxidized to **CO₂** while reducing **Fe₂O₃** to **Fe**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In redox reactions, the substance that gets oxidized (loses electrons) is the reducing agent.
 
• Fe₂O₃ is the oxidizing agent as it gains electrons and gets reduced to Fe.
 
• The reaction is a classic example of the reduction of metal oxides using carbon monoxide.
 
• Such reactions are commonly used in metallurgy for extracting metals from their ores.

questions.question:
A spherical mirror converges a beam of light, at a given point on the principal axis. Which of the following statement(s) about the mirror is/are true?

(a) The mirror used is concave

(b) The mirror has positive focal length

(c) The point of convergence is the principal focus of the mirror
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2 Both (a) and (c)**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A spherical mirror that converges a beam of light at a given point on the principal axis is a concave mirror. This is because only concave mirrors converge parallel rays of light to a single point known as the principal focus. **Hence, statement (a) is correct.**
 
• The focal length of a concave mirror is considered negative, not positive. Therefore, statement (b) is incorrect.
 
• The point where the converged light meets on the principal axis is indeed the principal focus of the concave mirror. **Hence, statement (c) is correct.**
 
• As a result, both statements (a) and (c) are true, making option 2 the correct choice.

questions.question: A boat starting from point P goes downstream to point Q in 3 hours and returns back from point Q to the point P in 4 hours. If the speed of the water is 3 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time downstream (P to Q) = 3 hours

Time upstream (Q to P) = 4 hours

Speed of stream = 3 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Speed downstream = Speed of boat in still water + Speed of stream

Speed upstream = Speed of boat in still water - Speed of stream

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the boat in still water be x km/h.

Speed downstream = x + 3,

Speed upstream = x - 3

Distance is the same for both downstream and upstream.

⇒ (x + 3) × 3 = (x - 3) × 4

⇒ 3x + 9 = 4x - 12

⇒ 4x - 3x = 9 + 12

⇒ x = 21 km/hr

**Thus, the speed of the boat in still water is 21 km/h.**

questions.question: A cosmetic product is available at 75% discount. If the shopkeeper charges Rs. 1,874, what is its marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 75%

Sale Price = Rs. 1,874

**Formula Used:**

Sale Price = Marked Price × (100 - Discount%) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ 1874 = Marked Price × (100 - 75) / 100

⇒ 1874 = Marked Price × 25 / 100

⇒ Marked Price = 1874 × 100 / 25

⇒ Marked Price = 7496

**The marked price is Rs. 7,496.**
